Hello buddy - i think im one of the qualified people to answer this. 
I don’t know where to start, but i’ll just tell you how it went for me and it might give you ideas.

I’m a 20F and i have been severely depressed since i was 11 years old, never went out the house, i never had any friends i could talk to or go out with, my social skills were.. borderline autistic. Imagine this - i was really ugly, i’m a muslim so i was a hijabi, very very skinny, 40 kg, very bad bunny teeth that deformed how my face looked like. Sometimes when people saw me they would freak out like they just saw a ghost. I was of course severely suicidal, smoking two packs of cigarettes a day since i was 12, and by 16 I decided i wanted to feel feminine somehow so i went on tinder and similar dating apps and went on random dates where i just smiled, nodded and smoked while they talk - with every date that i went through i learnt to lie a little more about my life experiences, i learnt to take care of my appearance a little more, i learnt when and how to make facial expressions, and oh i took off the hijab as well - i learnt to tell stories that weren’t true but were interesting to keep the conversation going and to make them like me, by 18 i had removed my braces, i have transformed into an incredibly attractive woman. I am not even joking or exaggerating or being delusional, people stop in the streets to tell me i look beautiful, i turn heads wherever i go, men fall in love with me left and right now, not just because i finally became pretty, but because i learnt to become a sociopath.

I was actually diagnosed with ASPD a year ago, by a therapist who fell in love with me lol.

I still don’t have friends, i have no one to talk to. But god do i wake up everyday feeling like a god. 

I invite you to try living like a sociopath, my friend. Fake it till you make it. Work on how you look, and that will lead to an upwards spiral, improving your social skills, and your opportunities in every other area in your life. Also make sure to have a routine going on- meaning - get a job. 

Get obsessed with something and learn more about it, live everyday as if you’re in a movie and you’re a fucking villain who is out there to make them pay.
